propositions: Each xdist worker (under -n 3 --dist worksteal) re-renders all 178 corpus bodies independently due to process-local lru_cache, causing three redundant full-corpus fills (~884 pandoc spawns each) where serial execution requires only one.

The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical parametrizations each recompute pass-1 render bit-for-bit identical to the value already cached by _rendered(), duplicating ~50% of their 23-25s runtime.

Replace process-local cache with a session-scoped disk artifact indexed by SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON files, wiki_render module source, and pandoc executable signature, shared across xdist workers via inter-process locking.

The artifact is sharded per stratum (code_arrow/table/prose) with worker probe order rotated by PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER index to avoid queue contention; atomic mkdir/replace/rmdir guarantee exactly one computation per stratum per session.

A loser worker blocked on the shared artifact has a 150s fallback deadline below the --timeout=300 guard, allowing graceful degradation to per-worker rendering if the winner crashes rather than deadlocking.
